passphrase.description:
Passphrase (12+ characters): a portable archive, opened with it instead
of ORBIT_MASTER_KEY. Empty = sealed with the master key.

s3_bucket.description:
S3: credentials come from the secrets backend (BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY,
BACKUP_S3_SECRET_KEY), never from here.

hide_local_login.description: hide the password form on /login (when SSO is available)

oidc_enabled.description: SPA shows the "Sign in with SSO" button

passwordless_enabled.description: SPA shows the "Sign in with a passkey" button

privileges.description:
Optional narrowing (never widens the owner's rights): only these
instance privileges, and read-only access to workspace content.

after_id.description: AfterID puts the page right after this sibling ("" = at the end).

starter.description: Starter creates the template's lists and first pages (default true).

remind_minutes.description: RemindMinutes before each occurrence; a negative value removes the reminder.

RemindMinutes reminds the workspace's members this many minutes before
each occurrence (nil = no reminder).

supported.description: the server has the projects API

labels.description: mode labels: one column each, in order

mine.description: Mine is the caller's latest personal notes, not pinned (Today only).

can_sign_up.description: an account can be made here (password sign-in isn't hidden)

expires_in.description: The refresh token is delivered as an HttpOnly cookie, never in the body.

attachments.description: Files on the note (images show on its card), in lists.

allow_admin.description: the IdP may grant admin (superuser) roles

content.description:
Content is the editor's JSON document; ContentText its plain text, kept
for search and previews.

cover.description: a gradient key or #rrggbb; empty = none

dev_theme.description: "" (as the instance) | none | a theme id

notify_prefs.description: NotifyPrefs is where each kind of notification goes besides the inbox.

refresh_token.description: Optional: browsers send the refresh token via the HttpOnly cookie instead.

must_change_password.description:
MustChangePassword forces the user to replace the password on next
sign-in. Defaults to true when omitted (an admin-set password is temporary).

new_password.description:
NewPassword (>= 8 characters), or Generate for a one-time temporary
password that is returned once.

after_id.description: create: place after this task ("" = at the end)

assignee_id.description:
AssigneeID is who it's for in a shared workspace (reminders go to them;
nil = to whoever created it).

git_dirty.description: a change didn't reach git yet (retried by the sync)

git_error.description:
GitError: the change is saved but didn't reach the linked issue (the
sync tries again).

git_host.description:
The git issue (or pull request) this task is, when it is one: a task
of a git-linked list, or a task linked by hand. GitIssueID is the
server's global id; GitRepo is "owner/repo" on GitHost (a base URL).

expires_in.description: The refresh token is delivered as an HttpOnly cookie, never in the body.

version.description:
Version is the version the editor started from; required with content.
A newer save by someone else makes this a 409 with the current page.

notify_prefs.description:
Per kind (reminder, assigned, workspace, activity, digest): also to my
devices (push) and/or my channels.

image.description: shown in the page (a raster image)

icon.description: an icon key (lucide name) or an emoji

broken_at.description: id of the first bad entry ("" if OK)

s3_bucket.description:
S3: credentials come from the secrets backend (BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY,
BACKUP_S3_SECRET_KEY), never from here.

privileges.description: Decoded scope for API responses (set in AfterFind / by the handler).

username.description: Username of the token's owner (admin list only).

has_passkey.description:
HasPasskey (set by the user list) reports a registered passkey, which
counts as the second factor.

last_login_at.description: LastLoginAt is the last completed sign-in (password, SSO or passkey).

locked_until.description:
LockedUntilView (derived) is LockedUntil while a lockout is active, for
the admin's user list; nil otherwise.

must_change_password.description: MustChangePassword forces a password change before any other action.

needs_otp_setup.description:
NeedsOTPSetup (set by the user list): two-factor is required for this
user (by the policy or per user) but not set up yet.

oidc.description:
OIDC is a derived flag (set by AfterFind): true for SSO-provisioned
accounts, whose identity fields are managed by the identity provider.

otp_required.description:
OTPRequired makes a second factor mandatory for this one user, on top of
the instance-wide otp_enforced policy (an LB Admin addition to the PKI model).

roles.description: Roles are the assigned RBAC roles; effective access is their union.

accent_color.description:
AccentColor is a personal #rrggbb accent that overrides the org accent for
this user only (empty = follow the org/developer-theme accent).

dev_theme.description:
DevTheme is this user's own developer theme, when the owner lets each
person choose: "" = as the instance, "none", or a theme id.

device_tz.description:
DeviceTZ is the zone the browser last reported, used for reminders
while Timezone is "local".

digest_enabled.description:
The daily summary: on or off, at "HH:MM" in the user's zone; DigestSent
is the local date it was last sent.

locale.description:
Locale is the interface language (en, pt), for text sent from the
server: push notifications, channels, the summary.

notify_events.description:
Notifications: master toggle for reminders (tasks due, events starting)
+ chosen channel keys (JSON []string), restricted to the channels the
admin has enabled.

page_editor.description:
PageEditor is how this user edits pages: "visual" (blocks, the default)
or "markdown" (the source). Pages are Markdown either way.

remote_images.description:
RemoteImages is whether pages show images from other sites at once
("always") or only after a click ("ask", the default): such an image
tells its site who reads the page, and when.

week_start.description: WeekStart is the first day of the week in calendars: 1 = Monday, 0 = Sunday.

prefix.description: the token's start, to tell links apart

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key; payload signed in X-Orbit-Signature
